manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{U} available if Naru Meha is in your hand, or {4}{U} otherwise
notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, cast Vantress Visions by paying {1}{U}, targeting Karn's ability.
Holding priority, if Naru Meha is in your hand, cast it by paying {2}{U}{U}.
If Naru Meha is on the battlefield, activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding {C} for each artifact you control.
Repeat from step 4.
If you control four or more artifacts, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, which can be used to copy Vantress Visions infinitely targeting any other abilities on the stack, or to blink any number of creatures infinitely.
